# Book App Error Handler

Review `samples/book-app-project/books.py` and
`samples/book-app-project/utils.py` for gaps and inconsistencies in error
handling. Focus on JSON loading and saving, file access, malformed records,
invalid user input, and whether failures are reported clearly without hiding
unexpected errors or losing existing data.

Return prioritized findings with file and line references, explain the user
impact, and suggest one consistent approach that fits this beginner-friendly
CLI app. Do not edit files.
